remarks_1999: Not recorded Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive in 1969 indicates, "Seen in Abiquiú, Dec. 1969. See notes made at the time on this 2nd Road to the Ranch (1964). Doris Bry showed me a color transparency of this (in her apartment) 4/6/70—taken recently in Abiquiú. She said that the road is the one to the Ghost Ranch and the 'view' is the place we stopped on the way back from the ranch, high up, at the turn in the road, with a long view down the river valley, to distant mesas, including the Abiquiú Mesa./Miss O'Keeffe told me the same thing." Backing inscription 2 may indicate preparatory work. See cat. nos. 1234, 1235, 1253–60, 1266, 1461, 1998,2000. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Road to the Ranch

description: A blue road twists like a ribbon over white earth in the foreground and rippling, brown hills in the background. Rising above the scene is a purple mesa and a distant, bright blue mountain range. The brown hills and mesa fade into flat, white earth as they stretch toward the bottom of the canvas.
title: Road to the Ranch
